rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban
No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Body reads factual/direct (Boris) with occasional Rory-flavored reframe (L27: "You hold the three lenses. You are not holding the codebase."); no atmospheric misfires, no Remember-wrapper, no negation-callout self-contradiction, no slang collisions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.

rules_evaluated.evidence: The exercise scopes verification to what the agent reads and reports (L27: "the agent reads that for you"); no full-coverage manual-audit claim on a large artefact.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No narrating student's past or present state.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The "What happened" recap (L97-98) names concrete artefacts produced ("a diagnosis... a working verifier... a reference artefact + plan.md"), matching check_writing §16's sanctioned artifact-narration shape rather than the banned vague pat-on-head ("You've done the work") shape.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No corrective-gap phrasing, no ability-level assumption ("at your scale", "for a beginner"); the L13 HOX pre-flight check (confirm you're in the M5 worktree, not M4) is plausibly-failable for this audience mid-worktree-fork.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "three failure-mode lenses" (L15) / "the three lenses" (L27) is used repeatedly in body prose, but the three lens NAMES (Goal drift / Context rot / Plausible-but-wrong) never appear in body prose itself — only inside the Phase-1 prompt fence (registry diagnose-and-resend-2). A reader who reads body only, without pasting/reading the fence, never learns what the three lenses are called. The maintainer's own note ("pre-read carries the colour, this exercise applies them") implies cross-file earning via prework, which is a legitimate design, but the file offers no body-prose confirmation that the pre-read actually names all three before this exercise runs.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Either name the three lenses once in body prose (e.g. in the L15 "What you do" line) for self-containedness, or add a one-line maintainer note confirming the pre-read spells out Goal drift / Context rot / Plausible-but-wrong before M5.
